project_scope.note: B009 Panicum set; P. coloratum is retained only as an introduced/invasive comparison.

study_strategy.warning: Do not identify these from a generic open panicle alone. Read the base, ligule/collar, leaf texture and panicle architecture together.

quick_key.if: tall rhizomatous native + huge airy pyramidal panicle + conspicuously hairy collar
annual + hairy nodes/sheaths + enormous chaotic diffuse panicle
short glaucous perennial + mostly basal leaves + smaller stiff ascending panicle
introduced tufted bunchgrass + firm knotty base + fine fan-shaped panicle
